name: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting Covariance Transformation and Regularization
aliases: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting (3D-HGS) Covariance Transformation and Regularization
summary: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting transforms covariance matrices to create flat half-ellipsoids, reducing blooming artifacts near sharp boundaries by enforcing zero variance along splitting plane normals.
